description: A module that drives the Rack window itself: cable tension, cable opacity, the zoom level and the scroll position all follow voltages patched into it

params.text: Turns the effect on and off; it comes up off every time the patch is loaded, and drops to off by itself when the rack is zoomed by hand while a cable is patched to the zoom input

inputs.text: Sets Rack's cable tension, 0V giving none and 10V the maximum
Sets Rack's cable opacity, 0V making cables invisible and 10V fully opaque
Sets the rack zoom to two raised to a fifth of the voltage, so -10V gives 25 percent, 0V gives 100 percent and 10V gives 400 percent
Scrolls the rack sideways from where it stood when the switch was turned on, ten pixels per volt and no further than 100 pixels
Scrolls the rack up and down from where it stood when the switch was turned on, ten pixels per volt and no further than 100 pixels

notes: the module changes nothing about the Rack window until the switch is turned on, and that switch is off every time a patch is loaded
moving the rack by hand while the effect runs moves the point the scroll inputs work from, so the view does not jump back
